claims.content: Customer
A NEW customer tries to create a new JTVauctions.com account

trigger.raw_text: A NEW customer tries to create a new JTVauctions.com account

claims.content: The system displays Registration Page 1 with a global site header, footer, and a welcome message.
The customer enters First Name, Last Name, Email Address (created and verified by entering twice), Password (created and verified by entering twice, 8 to 12 characters), and Member ID.
The system validates that the Email Address and Member ID are unique in the customer table.
The system completes the short registration process to create the account.

The system triggers an automated 'transactional' email with a Thank You message for registering, telling the customer to enable cookies and add the email address to their whitelist or Safe Senders list.
The system displays Registration Page 2 to collect additional information.
The customer enters the additional information required in order to ship winning orders and set email preferences.
The customer chooses to finish the member account process later instead of continuing to Registration Page 2 immediately (completing only the 'short process').
The system detects that the entered Email Address or Member ID is not unique in the customer table (Duplicate Account).
The system detects that the password fields do not match or the password is not between 8 to 12 characters.
A customer account is created.
An automated "transactional" email is triggered with a Thank You message for registering.
The customer is instructed to enable cookies and add the appropriate email address(es) to their whitelist, Safe Senders list, or address book/contact list.
Additional information required to ship winning orders and set email preferences is collected.
